snippet.title: Starshot Idle👾 | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Get Starshot Idle👽:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4408630/Starshot_Idle/
itch.io: https://jakeoreilly.itch.io/starshot-idle

Starshot Idle is a Retro Space-Themed Shooter Idle that sits on your desktop and runs while you work or game!

Destroy Aliens, earn Stars, upgrade EVERYTHING. Blast enemies, power up your ship, unlock stronger aliens, and watch your Stars soar.

#idlegame #starshotidle #trailer
